title: Understanding Invertibility
text: For a matrix to be invertible, it must be square and have full rank. If a matrix is not invertible, it means there is no unique solution to the equation involving that matrix.

title: Normal Equation
text: The normal equation for linear regression is given by theta $$=$$ (X**T * X)**(-1) * $$X^T$$ * $$y$$. If X is not invertible, you might need to use a different method like regularization.

hintAnswer: You cannot directly compute the inverse.
title: Matrix Inversion
text: What happens if the matrix $$X^T$$ * X is not invertible?
choices: You cannot directly compute the inverse.
You can still compute the inverse.
